tasks.spec:
You are a code worker. Your current working directory IS a git worktree of freytag-forge; edit files here directly. Do NOT git commit. You own ONLY: storygame/runtime/recent_cue.py (new), storygame/runtime/cloudflare.py, tests/test_recent_cue_reference.py (edit), tests/test_recent_cue_unit.py (new). Touch nothing else. Never weaken or delete an existing assertion.

BACKGROUND (verified; do not re-diagnose). tests/test_recent_cue_reference.py already reproduces the miss: after 'Open the drawer.' (accepted; it commits reveal k_sl_1a_f_r1 whose delivery_text ends 'A thin gap beneath its lower edge is wide enough for Kristin's fingers.', entity_ids ('kristin','michelle_drawer'); entity michelle_drawer has name 'drawer'), the follow-up 'Search the gap.' (also 'Feel along the gap.', 'Check the gap.') earns nothing, because reveal k_sl_1a_b_r0's action_evidence needs a word from ('drawer','KMS','workstation',"drawer's") and the command never says it. Those cases are strict xfails today (6 of them: 3 commands x FREYTAG_SEMANTIC_REVEAL 0/1). Accepted turns append a bounded `TurnRecord` (storygame/runtime/state.py: reveal_ids, affected_entity_ids, ...) to state.turn_records in RuntimeEngine._record_turn (storygame/runtime/engine.py); rejected turns append nothing; turn_records are saved and restored by RuntimeState.snapshot()/restore_snapshot(). The knowledge entries are in state.package.knowledge_indexes.by_id (fields entity_ids, delivery_text). Entity surface forms: storygame/runtime/knowledge.py::_entity_surface_forms (read it; reuse, do not duplicate).

DESIGN (Brandon-approved shape; implement exactly this, story-neutral, no story ids or story words in runtime code):
A new pure module storygame/runtime/recent_cue.py exposes `recent_cue_referent_text(state, player_input) -> str`, returning '' or the owner's name to append for EVIDENCE MATCHING ONLY. It derives everything from committed state: no new mutable field, nothing persisted, nothing sent to the narrator or any prompt. Rules, all required:
1. Source: only the LAST TurnRecord in state.turn_records, and only if it was recorded in the current scene (use state.turn_index and state.scene_entered_at_turn; if you cannot tell reliably, prove your rule with a test) and has reveal_ids. One accepted turn of life: any later accepted turn (it appends a record with no matching reveal) expires it. A rejected turn appends no record, so it neither refreshes nor expires the cue.
2. Cue = the knowledge entries named by that record's reveal_ids that have a non-blank delivery_text. Owner candidates = their entity_ids minus the protagonist (use the same protagonist notion knowledge.py uses; 'kristin' here) and minus entities whose surface forms the player already named. Apply only when exactly ONE distinct owner entity remains across the cue; zero or two-plus (ambiguous) => return ''. Never pick between owners.
3. The command must share at least one content word with a cue delivery_text (case-folded whole words, after removing a small closed stopword list: articles, possessives/pronouns like my/her/his/its/it, and prepositions like in/on/of/at/to/along/with/and, plus every word that appears in any closed synonym class of storygame/runtime/candidate_matcher.py _SYNONYM_CLASSES, so verbs like search/feel/check and positional words like beneath/under never count as the shared word). 'Search the gap.' shares 'gap'. 'Read the receipt.' shares nothing.
4. If the player's own command already names the owner (any surface form), return ''.
5. Return the owner's primary name (entity.name) only, never an alias list and never delivery text. The caller appends it: evidence_text = f"{player_input} {owner}".
6. This never grants a reveal by itself: it only changes the text that exact action-evidence matching sees; every reveal's full evidence, eligibility and prerequisites still apply. No permanent alias is created.

WIRING in storygame/runtime/cloudflare.py: ONE helper on the provider, e.g. `_evidence_input(self, player_input)`, returning player_input plus the appended owner. Use it at every EXACT/shadow evidence call site in assemble_turn_prompt (the uniquely_matched_authored_handoff call, the _exact_match_count tie check, the shadow matched candidate) so there is one matching path. Keep negation detection on the ORIGINAL player_input. Keep the narrator prompt's player_input and the semantic (LLM) matcher's input unchanged. Record on provider.last_reveal_selection a key such as 'recent_cue_owner' (the owner id/name or None) for telemetry, without changing existing keys.

TESTS.
(a) tests/test_recent_cue_reference.py: remove the xfail markers (the 6 reproduction cases must now pass) and keep every other test; they must pass under FREYTAG_SEMANTIC_REVEAL 0 and 1.
(b) New hermetic tests/test_recent_cue_unit.py for recent_cue_referent_text and the wiring, covering: expiration (an intervening accepted unrelated turn, e.g. 'Read the receipt.', then 'Search the gap.' earns nothing); one-turn life measured in ACCEPTED turns (a turn the provider/engine REJECTS between the cue and the follow-up does not expire it and writes no TurnRecord: make a provider response the engine rejects, e.g. an ineligible selected_knowledge_id, wrap in pytest.raises(ProposalValidationError) or what the engine actually raises, assert len(state.turn_records) unchanged, then the follow-up succeeds); scene change (after the cue, move to another scene with bench.core.advance_state_to_scene or by setting current scene/scene_entered_at_turn consistently, the cue no longer applies); ambiguity (a synthetic cue whose knowledge entry lists two non-protagonist entities returns '' — build it with a small fake state/knowledge object or a copied package with a modified knowledge entry, whichever is simpler; never edit data/); owner already named returns ''; no shared word returns ''; full-name/wrong-target negatives ('Search the gap beneath the drawer.' behaves exactly as before; 'Search the kitchen.' still resolves only the kitchen reveal); no reveal granted by the helper alone (a cue-sharing command whose other evidence groups are unsatisfied, e.g. 'Smell the gap.', earns nothing); save/load (snapshot() then restore_snapshot() into a fresh state after the cue turn, then 'Search the gap.' earns the card; and a snapshot taken BEFORE the cue turn does not carry a cue); telemetry key present. Use a provider offline with patched urlopen exactly as tests/test_recent_cue_reference.py does (reuse its helpers by copying, not importing from another test).

HOW TO RUN. First confirm `PYTHONPATH=$PWD /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -c "import storygame; print(storygame.__file__)"` prints a path inside this worktree. Then `PYTHONPATH=$PWD TMPDIR=/tmp /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q --no-cov -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_recent_cue_reference.py tests/test_recent_cue_unit.py tests/test_1a_gap_pointer.py tests/test_established_reveal_match.py tests/test_semantic_reveal_match.py tests/test_candidate_matcher.py tests/test_cloudflare_transport.py tests/test_cue_spent_reveal.py tests/test_reveal_universe.py tests/test_revealed_knowledge_ids.py` and ruff check / ruff format --check (line length 120) via /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/ruff on the four files. If an existing test outside your ownership fails because of the change, do not edit it: stop and report which test and why.

COMPLETION RULE: do not stop until the module, the wiring, the flipped reproduction and the unit tests all pass with ruff clean. Finish by listing the files changed and pasting the pytest output.
